response.sql:
SELECT e.status,
       AVG(b.amount - b.spent) AS average_amount_minus_spent,
       COUNT(*) AS budget_line_count
FROM budget AS b
JOIN event AS e
  ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE b.spent > 6.0
GROUP BY e.status;

assumptions.assumption: Count each qualifying budget line, including lines where amount or spent is missing; AVG ignores NULL differences and returns NULL when none are available for a status.
